panels.title: Latest month
panels.description: Most recent reference month with a published Selic accumulated rate in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS month
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest monthly rate
panels.description: Selic accumulated in the latest month in range (SGS 4390, % per month).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest month annualized
panels.description: Latest monthly rate compounded over 12 months: (1 + rate)^12 - 1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (power(1 + arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE / 100, 12) - 1) * 100 AS annualized
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Trailing 12 months
panels.description: Selic compounded over the 12 months ending at the latest month in range: product of (1 + monthly rate) - 1. Looks back before the range start when needed.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS last_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*) = 12 THEN (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 END AS trailing_12m
FROM d, l
WHERE ref_dt > last_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
  AND ref_dt <= last_dt

panels.title: Accumulated in range
panels.description: Selic compounded over every month in the selected range: product of (1 + monthly rate) - 1.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS accumulated
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Months observed
panels.description: Number of reference months with data in the range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS months
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Selic accumulated in month
panels.description: Monthly Selic rate (% per month) by reference month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Selic in month"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Rolling 12-month accumulated
panels.description: Selic compounded over the trailing 12 months ending at each reference month, next to that month's rate annualized ((1 + rate)^12 - 1).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value::DOUBLE / 100 AS rate
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
w AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    product(1 + rate) OVER w12 - 1 AS trailing_12m,
    count(*) OVER w12 AS months,
    power(1 + rate, 12) - 1 AS annualized
  FROM d
  WINDOW w12 AS (ORDER BY ref_dt RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 11 MONTH PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  CASE WHEN months = 12 THEN trailing_12m * 100 END AS "Trailing 12 months",
  annualized * 100 AS "Month annualized"
FROM w
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Accumulated since range start and year to date
panels.description: Selic compounded from the first month in range (growth of an investment earning Selic), and compounded since January of each calendar year.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value::DOUBLE / 100 AS rate
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE year(ref_dt) >= year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP)
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
r AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, product(1 + rate) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) - 1 AS since_start
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
y AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, product(1 + rate) OVER (PARTITION BY year(ref_dt) ORDER BY ref_dt) - 1 AS ytd
  FROM d
)
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  since_start * 100 AS "Since range start",
  ytd * 100 AS "Year to date"
FROM r
JOIN y USING (ref_dt)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Calendar-year accumulated
panels.description: Selic compounded per calendar year (full years overlapping the range); the current year is year to date.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  year(ref_dt)::VARCHAR AS year,
  count(*) AS months,
  (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS accumulated,
  avg(value)::DOUBLE AS avg_month,
  min(value)::DOUBLE AS min_month,
  max(value)::DOUBLE AS max_month
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE year(ref_dt) BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP) AND year($__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY year DESC

panels.title: Monthly rate by year
panels.description: Selic accumulated in each month (% per month), one row per calendar year overlapping the range, with the compounded year total.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  year(ref_dt)::VARCHAR AS year,
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 1)::DOUBLE AS "Jan",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 2)::DOUBLE AS "Feb",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 3)::DOUBLE AS "Mar",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 4)::DOUBLE AS "Apr",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 5)::DOUBLE AS "May",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 6)::DOUBLE AS "Jun",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 7)::DOUBLE AS "Jul",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 8)::DOUBLE AS "Aug",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 9)::DOUBLE AS "Sep",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 10)::DOUBLE AS "Oct",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 11)::DOUBLE AS "Nov",
  any_value(value) FILTER (WHERE month(ref_dt) = 12)::DOUBLE AS "Dec",
  (product(1 + value::DOUBLE / 100) - 1) * 100 AS year_total
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE year(ref_dt) BETWEEN year($__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP) AND year($__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY year DESC

panels.title: Monthly detail
panels.description: Every reference month in range: monthly rate, change vs the previous month (percentage points), the rate annualized, year-to-date and trailing 12-month compounded rates, and the SGS blocked flag.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value::DOUBLE / 100 AS rate, blocked
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_selic_monthly/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE ref_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
    AND ref_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
w AS (
  SELECT
    ref_dt,
    rate,
    blocked,
    rate - lag(rate) OVER (ORDER BY ref_dt) AS change,
    product(1 + rate) OVER (PARTITION BY year(ref_dt) ORDER BY ref_dt) - 1 AS ytd,
    product(1 + rate) OVER w12 - 1 AS trailing_12m,
    count(*) OVER w12 AS months
  FROM d
  WINDOW w12 AS (ORDER BY ref_dt RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL 11 MONTH PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
)
SELECT
  strftime(ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS month,
  rate * 100 AS rate,
  change * 100 AS change_pp,
  (power(1 + rate, 12) - 1) * 100 AS annualized,
  ytd * 100 AS ytd,
  CASE WHEN months = 12 THEN trailing_12m * 100 END AS trailing_12m,
  blocked
FROM w
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY ref_dt DESC
